name: Open Catalyst Project Benchmark
description: A large-scale benchmark for machine learning on catalytic materials, centered on predicting energies and related properties from catalyst structures and adsorbate configurations. It provides standardized splits and DFT-derived labels for broad catalyst generalization.
evaluation_method: Assess predicted energies and related properties against DFT ground truth using regression metrics such as MAE, with benchmark-specific split-based evaluation.
notes: The benchmark includes OC22-style oxide materials and multiple task definitions beyond adsorption energy. The prompt mentions a ~36% improvement for GemNet-OC but does not provide a directly comparable numeric score.
